title: AUDUSD 2015 pilot calendar-evidence hardening
objective: Preserve and classify the first real AUDUSD/2015 OANDA quarantine evidence, falsify the present-day calendar assumption without promoting a replacement rule, and define a gap-tolerant but evidence-explicit historical acceptance policy before any wider acquisition.
success_criteria: AUDUSD/2015 external evidence identity and hashes are recorded without price values or credentials
The 17:00 New York candidate is explicitly non-authoritative and cannot modify the RND-0030 calendar
Closure-shaped candidates, residual short gaps and remaining unexpected timestamps remain distinct
No missing candle is synthesized or silently reclassified
Future historical acceptance can retain explicit genuine gaps without requiring fabricated calendar exceptions
Cross-pair corroboration is required before wider historical-calendar adoption
No broker-write, strategy, capital, promotion or merge authority
stop_conditions: Any M005 signal, trade or performance calculation
Any returned candle promoted into calendar authority by itself
Any credential or account identity committed
